mechanism: Tolterodine is metabolized by CYP3A4; eplerenone may inhibit CYP3A4, increasing tolterodine levels and anticholinergic effects, while both drugs can cause electrolyte abnormalities and have potential additive cardiac effects.
action: Monitor for increased anticholinergic symptoms (urinary retention, constipation, tachycardia) and electrolytes; consider tolterodine dose reduction if CYP3A4 inhibition is clinically significant.
